item.title: ABB Introduces 315- and 355-kW Wall-Mounted Drives
item.description: The new frame delivers up to 355 kW in a compact wall-mounted format, responding to increasing demand for higher output power combined with limited installation space.

item.title: Fortress Technology Introduces Raptor Flex Automated Checkweigher System
item.description: A modular, standalone checkweigher for packaged products, the Raptor Flex is installed at the end of inspection lines to reduce product giveaway and ensure compliance with weight regulations.

item.title: Put Contextualized OEE Data to Use Managing Plantwide Processes
item.description: While OEE is a must-have for troubleshooting line problems, contextualized OEE data with its time signatures is a key input in analyzing when and what went wrong with a plant’s total production process, including wasted product and utilities. And it can even aid in the track-and-trace process.

item.title: Bel Group Begins $200M Expansion of South Dakota Plant
item.description: The investment will create around 150 new jobs and double milk sourcing from American dairy farms, primarily in South Dakota and neighboring states.

item.title: Melt&Marble Secures Self-Affirmed GRAS Status for MeltyMarble
item.description: MeltyMarble is a designer lipid inspired by animal fats and built to deliver targeted functionality across a range of food applications.

item.title: Shinkei Systems Acquires Washington Fish Processing Facility
item.description: The plant more than doubles Shinkei’s total footprint and represents a major milestone in the company’s mission to deliver fish under the Seremoni Grade brand.

item.title: Simplifying the Alphabet Soup of Industrial Networks
item.description: It used to be that if you used one particular vendor’s automation products or sensors, you were locked in forever. With today’s open standards-based networks, users are no longer locked in and can shop around for sensors, industrial PCs, PLCs and industrial network devices.

item.title: Rise Baking Company to Expand Utah Facility
item.description: The expansion will add approximately 115,000 sq. ft. of new manufacturing space to support operational efficiency, consistency and long-term growth nationwide.

item.title: Puratos to Acquire Dawn Foods
item.description: This combination would bring together complementary innovation engines — Dawn Foods' application-led creativity and Puratos' R&D-led ingredient technology — alongside complementary production models.

item.title: How Radio Frequency Drying Reduced Baking Carbon Emissions
item.description: When exposing a product with an uneven moisture content (moist interior/drier exterior) to a rapidly oscillating RF field, the energy will preferentially target and remove moisture from the moist interior without overheating or discoloring the exterior surfaces.
